scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed an excellent root cause analysis. It efficiently navigated initial path issues, systematically investigated the errors by project and target framework, verified the project file structure to confirm no conditional compilation existed, and produced a clear, well-structured diagnosis. The analysis correctly identifies the single root cause (unconditional inclusion of HotReload files in a multi-targeted project), explains the cascade mechanism, separates the net10.0 errors as distinct issues, and even provides a concrete fix suggestion using an existing pattern from the project. The approach was methodical and the output is thorough.

rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem
